verdict.rationale: Viam is a cloud robotics and fleet platform, so registrable outbound webhooks are a fair axis for it. The evidence only mentions fleet monitoring and alerting, and logic modules that can fire a notification. Neither is a documented, registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can subscribe to: alerting is an adjacent feature, and custom logic modules are developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
